description: Skybox CLI->MCP steering for Grok: on run_terminal_command (or Bash), detect skybox subcommands that have MCP equivalents and deny with guidance to use MCP tools instead (when daemon up).

hooks.command: PLUGIN_ROOT="${GROK_PLUGIN_ROOT:-${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}}"; if [ -z "$PLUGIN_ROOT" ] || [ ! -f "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skybox-enforce.sh" ]; then printf '{"decision":"allow"}\n'; exit 0; fi; sh "$PLUGIN_ROOT/hooks/skybox-enforce.sh"
